title: Morning Brief, Tue 17 Nov 2026: SAFF Championship final India vs Pakistan tonight 7:30 PM IST, National Stadium Dhaka, Veto app (lead); SC awards Rs 30 lakh to Devilal Gond, jailed 7+ years after HC acquittal (Jan 2018 to May 2025), notes no law for wrongful-jailing compensation; SC (DDA v Rajender Kumar Sharma) gratuity cannot be withheld because the State appealed an acquittal; PM Modi at 23rd ASEAN-India and 21st East Asia summits in Manila today, Quad meeting planned per PTI, unconfirmed; Iran's IRGC navy claims mines damaged 6 tankers in Hormuz since Sunday (unverified).

fact_sources.fact: SAFF Championship final India vs Pakistan, Tue 17 Nov, 19:30 IST, National Stadium Dhaka, streamed on Veto app
India holders, record nine titles (10th would extend); India beat Bhutan 2-1 in semi; Pakistan beat hosts Bangladesh 1-0; Pakistan's first SAFF final

SC (Justices Masih, Sachdeva, 16 Nov) awards Rs 30 lakh to Devilal Gond; Chhattisgarh HC acquitted him 20 Jan 2018, order never reached jail, released 19 May 2025; no statutory framework for wrongful-incarceration compensation

SC (16 Nov, DDA v Rajender Kumar Sharma): gratuity of acquitted retirees cannot be withheld merely because State's challenge to acquittal is pending; DDA withheld Rs 18,52,224 and Rs 15,43,113 under Rule 69(1)(c) CCS (Pension) Rules; acquittal holds the field; undertaking to refund with interest
Modi at 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit in Manila on 17 Nov; ASEAN has 11 members
Quad leaders' meeting planned on the sidelines (PTI); no official confirmation (The Week)
IRGC navy says mines damaged six oil tankers since Sunday; unverified; Iran warns the US-protected route is mined
Before the war the strait carried about a fifth of the world's oil
